objective: Earn attributable AI-search citations and referrals that land on the correct canonical, monetized decision tools without weakening factual integrity, Google search performance, or the human product experience.
principle: Optimize for source-worthiness and click-worthy utility, not for guessed AI ranking factors.
limitations: OpenAI does not publish a deterministic ChatGPT Search ranking formula. This benchmark is a release-readiness and measurement contract, not a citation guarantee.
Static answer length is a quality heuristic only. It is not treated as a known OpenAI ranking factor.
Natural web-search prompt tests are useful discovery proxies but are not proof of ChatGPT citation behavior.

referenceSurfaces.notes: Strong query-to-answer alignment and source transparency. Protect utility while learning from its answer architecture.
Large exposure with weak capture. Best surface for testing answer extraction plus interactive click value without rebuilding the product.
Official authority owns the basic open/closed fact. The product must earn clicks through synthesis, personalization, cameras, timing, and travel decision support.

terms.A: direct answer and conversational intent fit
terms.U: unique interactive utility that creates a reason to click

valueFunction.scale: Each term is scored 0-100 from observable evidence. The function is used for prioritization, not as a claim about OpenAI ranking.

terms.D: count of known wrong-host or duplicate-canonical citation destinations
terms.B: measurement blindness indicator: ChatGPT referrals/revenue cannot be attributed
terms.F: freshness/provenance failure indicator on a live or risk-sensitive answer
terms.G: material Google guardrail regression indicator on a protected winner

lossFunction.goal: Minimize loss. Any H > 0 blocks release regardless of the weighted value score.

hardVetoes: OAI-SearchBot is explicitly blocked from a target canonical surface.
A tracked main-site decision page is indexable or surfaced on an unintended host.
Canonical, indexability, or robots behavior points away from the intended production owner.
A live answer fabricates current data, certainty, thresholds, or source authority.
A change removes material source provenance or freshness context from a risk-sensitive decision.
A change breaks the existing analytics or advertising loader contract on an eligible page.
A new URL duplicates an existing canonical intent owner without materially distinct user value.

outcomeMetrics.citationPresenceRate: Share of tested AI-search prompts where an owned canonical is cited or linked. Measure externally; do not infer from static code.
outcomeMetrics.canonicalCitationRate: Among owned citations, share landing on the intended canonical host. Target 100%.
outcomeMetrics.chatgptReferralSessions: Sessions with source/referrer attributable to chatgpt.com, including utm_source=chatgpt.com where present.
outcomeMetrics.chatgptLandingPages: Referral sessions grouped by landing page and tool family.
outcomeMetrics.chatgptRevenue: Ad and downstream monetization attributable to ChatGPT referral sessions when analytics integration supports it.
outcomeMetrics.revenuePerChatgptSession: ChatGPT-attributed revenue divided by ChatGPT referral sessions.
outcomeMetrics.secondUsefulActionRate: Share of ChatGPT referral sessions that interact with the tool or continue to another relevant owned decision surface.
outcomeMetrics.googleGuardrails: Settled GSC impressions, clicks, CTR, and position on the same canonical surfaces over comparable windows.

executionOrder: Fix crawler and canonical-destination failures before content optimization.
Restore reliable ChatGPT referral and revenue measurement.
Use Soo Locks as the reference architecture rather than modifying it speculatively.
Run the first answer/click-value treatment on Northern Lights because demand is high and capture is weak.
Use Mackinac Bridge as the authority/synthesis test: official status first, differentiated decision utility second.
Expand only after prompt-level and business-outcome evidence shows a repeatable pattern.
